TextZh:
第{life}世。
{name}又醒了。
好消息：还能重来。
坏消息：又要从头练。
TextEn:
Life {life}.
{name} wakes up again.
Good news: another chance.
Bad news: training starts from zero again.

TextZh: 上一世失败了。\n这一世也未必成功。\n不过至少还有机会。
TextEn: Last life failed.\nThis one might fail too.\nBut at least there is another chance.

TextZh: 轮回这件事。\n说起来很玄幻。\n活起来很真实。
TextEn: Reincarnation sounds mystical.\nLiving through it feels very practical.

TextZh: {name}总觉得哪里不对。\n像是做过这套新手教程。\n很多次。
TextEn: {name} feels something is off.\nLike this tutorial has been done before.\nMany times.

TextZh: 这不是结束。\n只是读档点比较远。
TextEn: This is not the end.\nThe save point is just very far back.

TextZh:
第{life}世开局。
修为归零。
记忆模糊。
摆烂本能完整保留。
TextEn:
Life {life} begins.
Cultivation reset.
Memories blurred.
Slacking instincts fully retained.

TextZh: 上一世的遗憾还没散。\n{name}已经开始想午饭吃什么。
TextEn: The regrets of the last life haven't faded.\n{name} is already thinking about lunch.

TextZh: 有人轮回是为了变强。\n{name}轮回后第一反应：\n我存档了吗？
TextEn: Some reincarnate to grow stronger.\n{name}'s first reaction:\nDid I save?

TextZh: 天道又给{name}发了一张新牌。\n牌面依旧朴素。\n但这次手感熟一点。
TextEn: Heaven dealt {name} a new hand.\nStill modest.\nBut it feels slightly familiar this time.

TextZh: 前世的坑还在。\n这一世的脚已经抬起来了。
TextEn: The pit from last life remains.\nThis life's foot is already moving toward it.

TextZh: {name}隐约记得。\n有些丹不能乱吃。\n但具体是哪颗，忘了。
TextEn: {name} vaguely remembers some pills should not be eaten casually.\nWhich pills exactly? Forgotten.

TextZh: 上一世死因不重要。\n重要的是：\n这次能不能死得晚一点。
TextEn: The last cause of death is not the point.\nThe point is:\ncan death arrive later this time?

TextZh: 轮回没有说明书。\n{name}只有一点经验：\n看到雷，先躲。
TextEn: Reincarnation has no manual.\n{name} has one lesson:\nif you see lightning, dodge.

TextZh: 第{life}世。\n{name}决定认真修炼。\n这句话上一世也说过。
TextEn: Life {life}.\n{name} decides to train seriously.\nThis was also said last life.

TextZh: 天道很公平。\n每次都让{name}从头开始。\n公平得有点过分。
TextEn: Heaven is fair.\nIt makes {name} restart every time.\nA little too fair.

TextZh:
前世的经验告诉{name}：
突破前要冷静。
死亡前也要。
虽然通常来不及。
TextEn:
Past experience tells {name}:
stay calm before breakthroughs.
Also before death.
Though there is rarely enough time.

TextZh:
上一世留下了什么？
一点感悟。
一点遗憾。
和很多黑历史。
TextEn:
What did the last life leave behind?
A little insight.
A little regret.
And a lot of embarrassing history.

TextZh: {name}感觉自己变强了一点。\n也可能只是变熟练了。\n熟练地重开。
TextEn: {name} feels slightly stronger.\nOr maybe just more practiced.\nPracticed at restarting.

TextZh: 轮回路漫漫。\n{name}才刚刚继续。\n第一步：不要马上倒下。
TextEn: The reincarnation road is long.\n{name} continues.\nStep one: don't fall immediately.

TextZh: 有人千百世只为飞升。\n{name}这一世目标朴素：\n先别被鹅追杀。
TextEn: Some spend countless lives seeking ascension.\n{name}'s goal this life is simple:\navoid goose-related incidents.

TextZh: 上一世的失败没有白费。\n至少{name}知道：\n炸炉声音很大。
TextEn: Last life's failure was not wasted.\nAt least {name} knows:\nfurnace explosions are loud.

TextZh: {name}望着天空。\n天空还是没说话。\n但{name}觉得它在装。
TextEn: {name} looked at the sky.\nThe sky still said nothing.\n{name} suspects it is pretending.

TextZh:
第{life}世开始前。
{name}做了个决定：
这次低调一点。
除非突破成功。
TextEn: Before life {life}, {name} made a decision:\nstay low-profile this time.\nUnless the breakthrough succeeds.

TextZh: 修为归零不可怕。\n可怕的是。\n坏习惯也继承了。
TextEn: Reset cultivation is not scary.\nWhat is scary:\nbad habits were inherited too.

TextZh: 前世也许是天命。\n这一世可能是补考。
TextEn: The last life may have been destiny.\nThis life might be the retake exam.

TextZh: {name}不记得所有事。\n但身体记得。\n尤其记得被雷劈的方向。
TextEn: {name} doesn't remember everything.\nThe body remembers.\nEspecially the direction lightning came from.

TextZh:
这一世的{name}。
开局依然普通。
但眼神里多了一点：
我又来了。
TextEn: This life, {name} still starts ordinary.\nBut the eyes say one thing:\nI'm back.

TextZh: 轮回不是作弊。\n轮回是天道给的超长试用期。
TextEn: Reincarnation isn't cheating.\nIt's heaven's extended free trial.

TextZh: 上一世走错的路。\n这一世应该能避开。\n前提是{name}记得哪条是错的。
TextEn: The wrong path from last life should be avoidable.\nAssuming {name} remembers which one it was.

TextZh: {name}决定吸取教训。\n第一条教训：\n不要太相信自己的决定。
TextEn: {name} decides to learn from the past.\nLesson one:\ndo not trust {name}'s own decisions too much.

TextZh: 第{life}世的风。\n吹过熟悉的桌面。\n{name}感觉这地方有点眼熟。
TextEn: The wind of life {life} blows across the familiar desktop.\n{name} feels this place looks suspiciously familiar.

TextZh: 前世没能飞升。\n这一世至少要飞得高一点。\n哪怕只是被炸飞。
TextEn: The last life did not ascend.\nThis life should fly higher.\nEven if launched by an explosion.

TextZh: {name}醒来时只有一个念头：\n这次不要死得太有创意。
TextEn: When {name} woke up, one thought appeared:\ntry not to die too creatively this time.

TextZh: 轮回后，世界还是那个世界。\n{name}还是那个{name}。\n但失败经验增加了。
TextEn: After reincarnation, the world is still the same.\n{name} is still {name}.\nBut failure experience has increased.

TextZh: 上一世的称号已经过去。\n这一世的黑历史正在加载。
TextEn: The last title is gone.\nThis life's embarrassing history is loading.

TextZh: {name}觉得自己应该成熟了。\n然后决定先睡一觉冷静一下。
TextEn: {name} feels more mature now.\nThen decides to nap and calm down.

TextZh:
第{life}世。
修仙路重新开始。
唯一确定的是：
天道还没放过他。
TextEn:
Life {life}.
The cultivation road begins again.
One thing is certain:
heaven is not done with {name}.

TextZh: 有些错误犯一次叫年轻。\n犯很多次叫轮回。
TextEn: Making a mistake once is youth.\nMaking it many times is reincarnation.

TextZh: {name}带着微弱的前世感悟醒来。\n感悟内容：\n活着真好。
TextEn: {name} wakes with faint past-life insight.\nThe insight says:\nbeing alive is nice.

TextZh: 这一世不求一步登天。\n先求一步别踩坑。
TextEn: This life does not need instant ascension.\nFirst goal: don't step into the pit.

TextZh:
上一世的终点。
变成这一世的开头。
听起来很励志。
做起来很累。
TextEn: The last ending becomes this beginning.\nSounds inspiring.\nFeels exhausting.

TextZh: {name}又站在起点。\n这次不算新手。\n顶多算熟练新手。
TextEn: {name} stands at the starting line again.\nNot a beginner this time.\nMore like an experienced beginner.

TextZh: 轮回给了{name}一个机会。\n也给了天道一个机会。\n继续看笑话。
TextEn: Reincarnation gives {name} another chance.\nIt also gives heaven another chance\nto watch the comedy continue.

TextZh: 前世修到哪里不重要。\n重要的是。\n这一世还能不能超过昨天的自己。
TextEn: How far the last life reached is not everything.\nWhat matters is whether this life can surpass yesterday's self.

TextZh:
{name}决定这次稳一点。
不乱吃丹。
不乱渡劫。
不乱相信自己。
TextEn:
{name} decides to play safer this time.
No random pills.
No random tribulations.
No random trust in self.

TextZh:
第{life}世的目标：
比上一世多活一年。
听起来不难。
但{name}不敢保证。
TextEn:
Goal for life {life}:
live one year longer than last time.
Sounds easy.
{name} makes no promises.

TextZh: 死亡不是失败。\n只是修仙系统的重启按钮。\n按钮有点疼。
TextEn: Death is not failure.\nIt is the restart button of cultivation.\nThe button hurts a little.

TextZh: {name}带着一点点加成回来。\n虽然不多。\n但心理安慰很足。
TextEn: {name} returns with a tiny bonus.\nNot much.\nBut the emotional support is strong.

TextZh:
这一次。
{name}会不会改写命运？
不知道。
但至少又可以试一次。
TextEn: This time, will {name} rewrite fate?\nUnknown.\nBut at least there is another try.

TextZh: 就这样。\n第{life}世的修仙路。\n正式重新开始。
TextEn: And so,\nlife {life}'s cultivation journey\nofficially begins again.
